criteria.observation: Keeps released clients working on populated card files across both generations, site boundaries and slot reuse.
Reconciles compatible field and route changes and preserves disputed edits for later resolution.
Keeps sheet identity, per-member outcomes and partial work consistent across overlap and restart.
Publishes the accepted card revision to the printer and the installed monitor through overlapping activity.
Recovers interrupted dispatches through the supplier’s outcome protocol, preserving physical slips and their identities.
